name: asVereinbase
author: Alexander Suess

sections.description:
asVerein puts an end to complicated processes and confusing organization. Manage members, posts, and the members’ area centrally on your WordPress club website – clearly, securely, and efficiently.

You can:

  • Manage Members
  • Create Member-Area
  • Manage membership fees

Documentation

You can find additional information on the website https://asverein.de

Plugin Support

If you have any problem with asVerein plugin, please visit the plugin site and post it on the support forum or send us a contact:
https://asverein.de/support/

You can create a free forum user account and ask your questions.

External services

OpenIBAN
This plugin uses an API to verify a member’s IBAN. The entered IBAN is sent to openiban.com for verification.
This service is provided by openiban.com : terms of use, privacy policy.

Google reCAPTCHA
This plugin uses Google’s reCAPTCHA service to:
– Protect forms from spam submissions
– Verify human interaction with forms

Service provider: Google LLC
– reCAPTCHA Terms
– Google Privacy Policy

Google MAPS
This plugin uses Google’s Maps service to:
– Generate Geo-Location for Users
– Show Map with User-Location

Service provider: Google LLC
– reCAPTCHA Terms
– Google Privacy Policy

Language Translations

The following language translations are already available:

  • English
  • German
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/asverein-basic directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Create Database-Objects: asVerein->Options->DB
  4. Use the asVerein->Options screen to configure the plugin
  5. Create Pages for Registration, Login and Dashboard with Shortcode
  6. Create Members to Login in MemberArea
